exclusions.source_text: Must be ≥18 years of age, with documented RET-altered NSCLC
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 and life expectancy \>3 months at screening
Spinal cord compression or brain metastases. Patients with stable brain metastases can be enrolled.
Participants with active HIV infection. Patients living with HIV may be eligible if they have adequate CD4+ T-cell count and no history of AIDS-defining opportunistic infections in the past 12 months
Impaired hepatic or renal function, inadequate bone marrow reserve or organ function
Impaired hepatic or renal function, inadequate bone marrow reserve or organ function
congestive heart failure Grade III-IV according to the New York Heart Association, myocardial infarction, or unstable angina within the previous 6 months
exclusions.threshold: NYHA Grade III-IV; MI or unstable angina within 6 months

exclusions.source_text: Any clinically important abnormalities in rhythm, conduction, or morphology on resting ECG or any factor that increases the risk of QTc prolongation or of arrhythmic events
